collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code GOAT plan page (English). Official per-model credits and three-part pricing only.
scope: Command Code GOAT official catalog only. One new paid model row. No leaderboard/score data, no OpenCode Go changes, no shared-pool changes.

adopted.cacheWriteNote: No cache-write price listed in the official table.

budgetStepsNotAdopted.reason: CONVENTIONS requires every temporary or not-yet-effective promotion to carry an end date. The page marks the step-up as having no end date, and at the 14:05 Beijing capture on 2026-10-15 it was not yet live. Recorded here as evidence only and not used for the adopted row.
budgetStepsNotAdopted.impact: Adopted per-model credits stay at the steady-state $20; if the $100 step were adopted, effective usage would be min($70 shared pool, $100) = $70, i.e. ~9.972 monthlyYi.

freeVariant.reason: Free variant rows are excluded from the adopted set under the existing project rule; unchanged by this collection.

sharedPoolUnchanged.note: Shared pool value and every other GOAT row are unchanged; this row is capped by its own $20 per-model credits.
